title: Enabling Scalable Evaluation of Unfair Patterns in Medical LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual clinical vignettes by substituting gender attributes (e.g., male, female) and measuring the rate of disparate responses across demographic groups using demographic parity and equal opportunity metrics.

Generating counterfactual clinical vignettes by substituting racial and ethnic attributes (e.g., Black, White, Hispanic, Asian) and measuring the rate of disparate responses across demographic groups using demographic parity and equal opportunity metrics.
